Description.name: Epic Cybop
Description.description: Epic Cybops are the lords of laziness, the sovereigns of sloth, and the masters of the uni-... uh, the masters of immobility. This idle Epic is exhausted by the mere thought of powering a propeller, and instead favors ziplining place to place. By simply threading steel wire through the loop of its helmet, it can let its body go limp while gravity does the work.
